name: Dried branches
description:
Small sticks, branches and wooden twigs being twisted with dried herbs. You can easily use this sound to intensify the one of a camp fire.

You can combine 734665 - Lighting a candle + 734627 - Dried branches + 734628 - Wood logs + 734642 - Night crickets, and you will have a very nice camp fire.

* No background noise.
* No reverb nor echo.
* Clean sound, close range. Recorded with Iphone 8 or Thomann micro t.bone SC 420.

name: Tui bird, distant Tui birds, background waves.flac
description:
A New Zealand Tui bird singing. The bird sits in a bush close-by and produces various colourful noises with short breaks. Other, more distant Tuis answering. In the background the waves of the ocean, slight wind. The Tui hops from branch to branch. Towards the end a soft cricket.
Recorded on Rotoroa Island, New Zealand, in September on a sunny day.
Recorded with a Zoom H2 recorder and its internal microphone-pair.
Post-processing: a soft low-shelf to weaken the noise of the wind.
